# DSH Desktop
> An Electron shell for DeepSeek Harness that runs the **official, unmodified** dsh Web UI — on Wind
ows, Linux and macOS. Also the reference implementation if you want to build your own shell.

Real capture — no mockup. The official dsh Web UI inside the shell. This frame comes from the
Electr

on on HarmonyOS Edition (same shell, same Web UI, same data plane),
because it is the edition with a
ready device shot; the desktop build loads the identical, unmodified UI.
**Status** `0.2.2` — packaging works on all three platforms; tray, native notifications, native wind
ow frame, clipboard image paste, window-state persistence and F11 are in. **No auto-update, no code
signing, no store distribution yet.**
## Why this shell
Three decisions, and they are the whole design:
| Decision | What it means |
| **Zero upstream changes** | The renderer loads `dsh web`'s own SPA same-origin. Only three idempot
ent patches are applied, all of them Electron-compatibility toggles (HMR off, native directory picke

r off, onboarding steps off) — no fork, no re-implementation of the UI. |
| **No CORS, no auth dance
, no custom protocol, no IPC carrier** | The dsh Host starts *inside the Electron main process*, and
its webserver serves both `dist/` and `/api` on one bound port. The window is a browser pointed at

`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/`. |
| **Linux is a first-class target** | `.deb` and `.rpm` ship next to t
he Windows installer and the macOS DMG. Most dsh desktop shells stop at Windows/macOS. |
## Features
| Capability | State |

| System tray (quit / restore) | ✅ |
| Native notifications, subscribed to dsh session events | ✅ |

| Native window frame (system min / max / close) | ✅ |
| Clipboard image paste | ✅ |
| Window state

persistence (maximized / bounds restored) | ✅ |
| F11 fullscreen | ✅ |
| Global shortcut · launch at
login · multiple windows | ⏸ deferred |
The native file picker reuses dsh's standard in-app directory browser (one of the three patches), so
no OS dialog is involved.
## Download
| Platform | Artifact | Notes |

| Windows x64 | Setup.exe · portable ZIP | Squirrel installer, **unsigned** |
| Linux x64 | `.deb` ·

`.rpm` · ZIP | Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/RHEL |
| macOS arm64 | `.dmg` · ZIP | **Unsigned** — Gateke
eper needs a manual allow |
**HarmonyOS editions (2in1 / tablet)** live in separate repos. dsh-desktop-hos — **Electron on Harmo
nyOS Edition** — shares this shell architecture and the same unmodified Web UI, with the Electron ru
ntime swapped for the Electron-on-HarmonyOS one; there is no consumer installer yet (AppGallery trac
k). dsh-desktop-ark — **HarmonyOS Edition** — keeps the same in-process Host but drops Electron: the
system ArkWeb renders the UI while an embedded Node runtime (`ohos-node-bridge`) runs dsh; it is 0.
2.2, device-verified on HarmonyOS 6.1.0.135 (API 24).
Everything here is local `npm run make` output: no signing, no notarization, no auto-update. If that
matters to you, build it yourself — see Development.
## Compatibility
| Shell | dsh (upstream tag) | Electron | Platforms | Verified |
| `0.2.2` | `dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1` | `43.0.0` | Windows x64 · Linux x64 · macOS arm64 | artifacts produce
d by `npm run make`; runtime exercised via `npm start` |
Upstream dsh is a **developer preview** and ships breaking changes. This shell pins one tag at a tim
e: bumping it means adding `patches/<new-tag>/` and updating the pin in `scripts/build-dsh.mjs`.
## Also a reference implementation
Most dsh desktop shells are products. This one is deliberately documented like a specimen, so the wo
rking parts can be copied into your own shell:
- `specs/` — as-built specs: host, window, tray, notifications, lifecycle, preload, app entry, deskt

op profile, plugin market
- `patches/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1/` — the three patches, each with its reason
- `

AGENTS.md`, `docs/000-产品概念设计.md` — architecture and working conventions
- `scripts/build-dsh.mjs` ·
`collect-dsh.mjs` · `fetch-runtime.mjs` — reproducible build, artifact collection, bundled-runtime c
ct-dsh.mjs` · `fetch-runtime.mjs` — reproducible build, artifact collection, bundled-runtime channel
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No preload bridge, no window-control channel: the renderer uses dsh's existing `WebApiClient` (HTTP
uplink + WebSocket downlink) against the same origin. Tray and notifications are produced in the mai
n process by subscribing to `ctx` session events.
## Tech stack

- **Electron** + **Electron Forge** (scaffolding & packaging)
- **deepseek-harness** (`dsh`, a sibli
ng directory of this project, not a submodule, referenced as `../deepseek-harness`; consumed via loc
al source reference) — current build is based on **`dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1`**; its patches live in `patches

/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1/`
- **dsh-market** (a sibling directory, referenced as `../dsh-market`; the built-i

n visual plugin marketplace — npm package `dshmarket`)
- **TypeScript**
## Development
### Integration approach
- **Source reference**: dsh lives in a sibling directory (`../deepseek-harness`, not a submodule); w
e consume its build artifacts. The plugin marketplace dsh-market likewise lives in a sibling directo
ry (`../dsh-market`, npm package `dshmarket`); its build output is materialized into dsh's `node_mod

ules/dshmarket` and bundled as a built-in plugin. Both siblings are required for a build.
- **Host i
ntegration**: `src/main/host.ts` dynamically imports dsh's `runProfile` (apps/cli build artifact), h
osting the dsh Host in the main process (webserver bound to `127.0.0.1:<free port>`), returning a `{

ctx, shutdown, port, url }` handle.
- **Same-origin data plane**: the renderer does `loadURL(http:/
/127.0.0.1:<port>/)` to load the dsh Web UI same-origin, reusing `WebApiClient` (HTTP uplink + WebSo

cket downlink) — zero CORS, zero auth, zero new carrier.
- **desktop profile**: `profiles/desktop/`
(`dsh.profile.bundles = [dsh-base, dsh-web-app]`, with cordis.patch.yml overriding `web-runtime.prin
tUrl: false`), copied to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop` at runtime.
